detail.abstract: The increasing importance of energy transition metals (ETMs) in achieving net-zero emissions extends beyond commodity markets and affects the economy. We examine the impact of the real prices of ETM on headline inflation, interest rates, unemployment rates, and current account balances for 31 International Energy Agency member countries. We apply both panel linear and nonlinear regime-switching local projection that adopt cumulative return of the ETM price, renewable energy consumption changes and uncertainty as transition variables. The study results reveal that the macroeconomic effects of ETMs are regime-dependent. The inflationary effects of real prices of ETMs are more pronounced when their returns are high and when renewable energy consumption shows higher change and uncertainty. Interest rates generally decline following increases in real prices of ETMs, predominantly during periods of low returns and low renewable energy consumption; however, they tend to rise, particularly during uncertainty in renewable energy consumption or in response to positive price shocks to lithium and rare earth elements or the common factor among the five metals. Positive shocks to ETM prices reduce unemployment and are intensified when renewable energy consumption and its uncertainty are high. Finally, ETM prices cause current account surpluses during periods of high returns of metal prices and high uncertainty of renewable energy consumption. These suggest that ETM prices should be incorporated into monetary and structural policies.

title: The Dignity Equilibrium: A Symbolic Extension of Nash

detail.title: The Dignity Equilibrium: A Symbolic Extension of Nash
detail.abstract: Classical Nash equilibrium assumes material payoffs alone drive rational choice. Yet in politics, culture, and international relations, actors often sacrifice resources or endure losses for honor, recognition, or dignity. Why? We introduce the Dignity Equilibrium: a symbolic extension of Nash equilibrium where payoffs are weighted by dignity sensitivity (λ) and recognition feedback (α). This framework reveals new equilibrium regimes—stable defiance, reconciliation, or cooperation—that classical models miss. It explains behaviors long deemed “irrational,” such as costly resistance or cooperation against incentives. By embedding dignity directly into the utility function, the Dignity Equilibrium reframes rationality itself: recognition and humiliation become as decisive as material payoff.

detail.abstract: This paper investigates whether large language models (LLMs) can improve cross-sectional momentum strategies by extracting predictive signals from firm-specific news. We combine daily U.S. equity returns for S&P 500 constituents with high-frequency news data and use prompt-engineered queries to ChatGPT that inform the model when a stock is about to enter a momentum portfolio. The LLM evaluates whether recent news supports a continuation of past returns, producing scores that condition both stock selection and portfolio weights. An LLM-enhanced momentum strategy outperforms a standard longonly momentum benchmark, delivering higher Sharpe and Sortino ratios both in-sample and in a truly out-of-sample period after the model's pre-training cutoff. These gains are robust to transaction costs, prompt design, and portfolio constraints, and are strongest for concentrated, high-conviction portfolios. The results suggest that LLMs can serve as effective real-time interpreters of financial news, adding incremental value to established factor-based investment strategies.

AI.tldr: 本研究探讨大型语言模型(LLMs)能否通过从公司特定新闻中提取预测信号来改进横截面动量策略。研究发现，基于ChatGPT的LLM增强动量策略在样本内和样本外均优于标准动量基准，夏普比率和索提诺比率更高。
AI.research_question: 大型语言模型(LLMs)能否通过从公司特定新闻中提取预测信号来改进横截面动量策略？
AI.motivation: 传统动量策略可能无法充分利用新闻信息，而LLMs具有实时解读金融新闻的潜力，可以为既有的基于因子的投资策略增加增量价值。
AI.theoretical_framework: 横截面动量策略、行为金融学、信息处理理论
AI.method: 结合标普500成分股的日度股票收益与高频新闻数据，使用提示工程设计的查询让ChatGPT评估近期新闻是否支持过去收益的延续，生成评分用于股票选择和投资组合权重确定。
AI.findings: LLM增强的动量策略在样本内和样本外均优于标准动量基准，夏普比率和索提诺比率更高，对交易成本、提示设计和投资组合约束具有稳健性，在集中的高确信度投资组合中表现最强。
AI.theory_contributions: 证明了LLMs可以作为金融新闻的有效实时解释器，为既有的因子投资策略提供增量价值，拓展了人工智能在金融分析中的应用边界。
AI.practical_contributions: 为投资经理提供了基于LLM的动量策略改进方法，能够通过新闻分析提升投资组合表现，特别是在高确信度投资决策中效果显著。

title: KFIA-Net: A Knowledge Fusion and Imbalance-Aware Network for Multi-Category​ SAR Ship Detection
affiliations: National University of Defense Technology, National University of Defense Technology, National University of Defense Technology, National University of Defense Technology, National University of Defense Technology, National University of Defense Technology and National University of Defense Technology

detail.title: KFIA-Net: A Knowledge Fusion and Imbalance-Aware Network for Multi-Category​ SAR Ship Detection
detail.abstract: Multi-category synthetic aperture radar (SAR) ship detection is limited by heterogeneity in imaging mechanisms and severe class imbalance, yielding accurate localization but frequent misclassification. To address this issue, this paper proposes a Knowledge Fusion and Imbalance-Aware Network (KFIA-Net). Specifically, we first propose a Domain Knowledge Feature Extraction (DKFE) to extract and encode knowledge tokens from four priors. Second, a Knowledge Cross-Attention Fusion (KCAF) module is designed to perform interpretable and sparsely selectable channel modulation using cross-attention and FiLM decoding.  Thirdly, we further design an Imbalance-Aware Loss Function (IALF) that combines prior calibration, minority category margin expansion, and knowledge-consistency weighting to reduce loss bias. Finally, systematic experiments and comparisons are conducted on three datasets: SRSDD-v1.0, FAIR-CSAR-v1.0, and NUDT-SARship-v1.0. Our KFIA-Net achieves mAP50 scores of 64.29%, 37.99%, and 78.26%, and mAP75 scores of 34.96%, 19.70%, and 66.36%, respectively. These results demonstrate knowledge injection simultaneously improves class accuracy and sustains robust localization. Furthermore, KFIA-Net requires only 11.47M parameters and 66.79G FLOPs, achieving an inference speed of 47.21 FPS on a 1024×1024 input, achieving a good trade-off between accuracy and efficiency.

AI.tldr: 本文提出KFIA-Net网络解决SAR多类别船舶检测中的成像机制异质性和类别不平衡问题，通过知识融合和失衡感知方法提升分类准确性同时保持定位鲁棒性。
AI.research_question: 如何解决多类别SAR船舶检测中的成像机制异质性和严重类别不平衡导致的定位准确但分类错误问题？
AI.motivation: 多类别合成孔径雷达船舶检测受成像机制异质性和严重类别不平衡限制，导致准确定位但频繁误分类。
AI.theoretical_framework: 知识融合理论、类别不平衡处理理论、注意力机制理论
AI.method: 提出KFIA-Net网络，包含：1) 域知识特征提取模块从四个先验中提取知识令牌；2) 知识交叉注意力融合模块进行可解释的稀疏选择性通道调制；3) 失衡感知损失函数结合先验校准、少数类别边界扩展和知识一致性加权

AI.theory_contributions: 1) 提出知识融合框架提升SAR船舶检测性能；2) 设计失衡感知损失函数解决类别不平衡问题；3) 验证知识注入同时提升分类准确性和定位鲁棒性
AI.practical_contributions: 1) 提供高效的SAR船舶检测解决方案；2) 在精度和效率间取得良好平衡；3) 为实际应用提供可部署的轻量级模型

title: Max-Neef’s ‘Threshold Hypothesis’ – 30 years later
affiliations: Universidad Austral de Chile and affiliation not provided to SSRN

detail.title: Max-Neef’s ‘Threshold Hypothesis’ – 30 years later
detail.abstract: Thirty years ago, this journal published a brief article by the Chilean economist Manfred Max-Neef in which he proposed a "threshold hypothesis": there is a GDP level after which economic growth may lead to a deterioration in the quality of life rather than its improvement. Does the hypothesis stand to the new and better data available? This paper addresses this question. First, it provides methodological clarifications which are relevant to the testing of the hypothesis, which have so far overlooked in the literature. Key is that the hypothesis as defined by Max-Neef is not really testable, so a weaker version is proposed. Second, in light of these clarifications, we test this weaker version using all ISEW data available to date, as well as life satisfaction data. Both indicators do not support the threshold hypothesis. Empirical caveats remain in place, particularly in the lack of coherence across ISEW/GPI studies. Many gaps remain for further research.

AI.tldr: 本文重新检验了Max-Neef提出的'阈值假说'，即存在一个GDP水平，超过该水平后经济增长可能导致生活质量下降而非改善。通过方法学澄清和使用最新数据，研究发现该假说缺乏实证支持。
AI.research_question: Max-Neef提出的'阈值假说'是否经得起新数据的检验？
AI.motivation: 三十年前提出的阈值假说需要基于更新更好的数据进行重新验证，现有文献在方法学上存在忽略。
AI.theoretical_framework: Max-Neef的阈值假说理论框架，即经济增长与生活质量关系的非线性理论。
AI.method: 提供方法学澄清，提出弱化版本的假说，使用所有可获得的ISEW数据和生活满意度数据进行检验。
AI.findings: ISEW数据和生活满意度数据均不支持阈值假说，实证研究存在局限性。
AI.theory_contributions: 澄清了阈值假说的方法学问题，提出了可检验的弱化版本假说。
AI.practical_contributions: 为经济增长与生活质量关系的研究提供了新的实证证据和方法学指导。

title: A Closed-Form Model of Advertising Intensity and Market Structure
affiliations: Universidad de Costa Rica

detail.title: A Closed-Form Model of Advertising Intensity and Market Structure
detail.abstract: This paper develops a closed form model that relates advertising intensity and market concentration. The shape of this relationship depends on the combative (or market share) effect of advertising. If this effect does not exist, advertising intensity falls as an industry fragments. If the combative effect is moderate, there is an inverted U relationship between advertising intensity and market structure. When the combative effect is very strong, advertising intensifies when there are more competitors. This paper studies whether advertising aids competition or monopolization, and if there is excessive or insufficient advertising.

AI.tldr: 本文开发了一个封闭模型，研究广告强度与市场集中度之间的关系。这种关系的形状取决于广告的竞争性效应。当不存在竞争性效应时，广告强度随行业分散而下降；当竞争性效应适中时，广告强度与市场结构呈倒U型关系；当竞争性效应很强时，广告强度随竞争者增多而增加。
AI.research_question: 广告强度与市场集中度之间的关系是什么？广告是促进竞争还是垄断？是否存在过度或不足的广告？
AI.motivation: 理解广告在市场结构中的作用，探究广告对竞争和垄断的影响，以及广告投入是否合理。
AI.theoretical_framework: 广告的竞争性效应理论，市场集中度与广告强度的关系模型。
AI.method: 开发封闭形式的数学模型来分析广告强度与市场集中度的关系。
AI.findings: 广告强度与市场结构的关系取决于竞争性效应的强度：无效应时呈负相关，中等效应时呈倒U型关系，强效应时呈正相关。
AI.theory_contributions: 提出了一个理论框架来解释广告强度与市场结构之间的复杂关系，揭示了竞争性效应的关键作用。
AI.practical_contributions: 为企业和政策制定者提供了关于广告策略和市场结构的决策依据，有助于识别过度或不足的广告投入。

title: YYA Concept Note Series | AIM: Adaptive, Inclusive & Moral Political Economy

detail.title: YYA Concept Note Series | AIM: Adaptive, Inclusive & Moral Political Economy
detail.abstract: AIM (Adaptive, Inclusive, Moral) Political Economy is a new paradigm created by Yuen Yuen Ang for a disrupted, multipolar world. It challenges the default "industrial-colonial" paradigm, inherited from the 18th-20th centuries, what she calls the Age of Domination. That chapter in human history brought material and social progress through the spread of modernization, but it also led humanity into the "polycrisis" in the 2020s. Designed for today's Age of Disruption, AIM reshapes the way we study political economies through a unique blend of three pillars: • Adaptive = replace machine-thinking with systems-thinking • Inclusive = replace one-size-fits-all Western templates with a diversity of local solutions and pathways • Moral = replace feigned neutrality with awareness of how power and positionality shapes ideas.

AI.tldr: AIM政治经济学是Yuen Yuen Ang为多极化和动荡世界创建的新范式，挑战工业-殖民范式，强调适应性、包容性和道德性。
AI.research_question: 如何为当今动荡多极的世界构建新的政治经济学范式？
AI.motivation: 工业-殖民范式虽然带来现代化进步，但也导致了2020年代的复合危机，需要新的理论框架来应对当今时代的挑战。
AI.theoretical_framework: AIM政治经济学理论框架，包含三个支柱：适应性（系统思维替代机械思维）、包容性（多元化本地方案替代西方模板）、道德性（权力和立场意识替代虚假中立）。
AI.method: 理论构建和范式分析，通过批判现有工业-殖民范式并提出替代性理论框架。
AI.findings: AIM范式能够更好地理解和应对当今世界的复杂性和多样性，为政治经济学研究提供新的视角。
AI.theory_contributions: 提出了AIM政治经济学新范式，挑战了传统的工业-殖民范式，为政治经济学理论发展提供了创新性贡献。
AI.practical_contributions: 为政策制定者和研究者提供了应对当今世界复杂挑战的新思维工具和方法论框架。

title: Green Growth or Degrowth? Green Transition under Ecological Limits
affiliations: École normale supérieure Paris-Saclay and Institut National de la Recherche Agronomique

detail.title: Green Growth or Degrowth? Green Transition under Ecological Limits
detail.abstract: Can economies grow while staying within ecological limits? We revisit the directed technical change framework of Acemoglu, Aghion, Bursztyn and Hemous's "The Environment and Directed Technical Change" (2012) by relaxing two assumptions central to the green-growth versus degrowth debate. First, we assume that the clean sector also relies on an exhaustible resource (e.g., critical minerals), alongside the dirty sector’s reliance on fossil fuels. When the clean resource is relatively costly, a carbon tax induces a larger transitional slowdown than in models without clean-resource scarcity. Long-run green growth remains feasible if clean-resource prices rise and clean R\&D is permanently subsidized. Second, we impose a no-backstop cap on the clean share of output, capturing thermodynamic limits to substitution. This yields a finite maximum sustainable scale and requires permanent climate policy: if the cap is far away, policy achieves strong decoupling and then stabilizes the economy at a sustainable level (green growth); if close, managed degrowth becomes necessary. Our analysis suggests that even modest strong-sustainability assumptions, when introduced into an otherwise optimistic green-growth framework, reinforce the message that climate policy must be a lasting institution.

AI.tldr: 本文重新审视了定向技术变革框架，通过放宽绿色增长与去增长辩论中的两个核心假设：清洁部门也依赖枯竭性资源（如关键矿产），以及清洁产出份额存在热力学上限。研究发现，清洁资源稀缺会放大碳税带来的转型放缓，而替代限制则决定了经济最终是走向绿色增长还是管理性去增长。
AI.research_question: 在考虑清洁资源稀缺和热力学替代限制的情况下，经济能否在生态限制内实现增长？
AI.motivation: 重新审视Acemoglu等人(2012)的定向技术变革框架，通过放宽绿色增长与去增长辩论中的两个核心假设，更现实地分析经济增长与生态限制的关系。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于Acemoglu等人的定向技术变革框架，但放松了两个关键假设：清洁部门也依赖枯竭性资源，以及清洁产出份额存在热力学上限。
AI.method: 理论模型分析，通过修改现有框架的假设条件来探讨不同情景下的经济增长路径。
AI.findings: 1) 清洁资源稀缺会放大碳税带来的转型放缓；2) 长期绿色增长需要清洁资源价格上升和持续的清洁研发补贴；3) 替代限制决定了经济最终是走向绿色增长还是管理性去增长。
AI.theory_contributions: 将强可持续性假设引入乐观的绿色增长框架，揭示了气候政策作为持久制度的必要性，为绿色增长与去增长辩论提供了更现实的理论基础。
AI.practical_contributions: 强调了气候政策的持久性需求，为政策制定者提供了在不同情景下（绿色增长vs管理性去增长）制定长期气候政策的理论依据。

title: Bioeconomic optimisation of surveillance for detecting and eradicating quarantine forest pests and pathogens
affiliations: affiliation not provided to SSRN, University of Maryland, National Institute for Agricultural and Food Research and Technology (INIA) and affiliation not provided to SSRN

detail.title: Bioeconomic optimisation of surveillance for detecting and eradicating quarantine forest pests and pathogens
detail.abstract: Early detection is critical for effective responses to incursions of invasive species, making surveillance programs for potential invaders essential. As resources are limited, surveillance activities must be as effective and efficient as possible. We used a bioeconomic model to develop an optimal surveillance programme for six priority quarantine and two quarantine forest pests in Switzerland. We aimed to minimize costs of management (i.e., surveillance and eradication) for species that are mandated for eradication based on collaborative biosecurity agreements with the European Union. The model determined optimal surveillance effort, accounting for differences in introduction likelihood, detectability, and spread rates, across pests and locales. The model suggested a conservative estimate of optimal investment of 1,187,000 CHF per year for surveillance using visual surveys and insect or spore traps, depending on the target species. Survey recommendations varied across locales and pest types with the greatest surveillance effort for Agrilus planipennis, Bursaphelenchus xylophilus, Dendrolimus sibiricus, Fusarium circinatum, and Phytophthora ramorum. Surveillance trapping would be economically irrational for two pests (Anoplophora glabripennis, A. chinensis) because of low efficacy of formal surveys, low spread rates, and high estimated probability of background detection by the public. The model indicates where in Switzerland surveillance yields the highest economic return, with greater survey effort in areas with highest introduction risk and for species with low likelihoods of public detection and fast spread rates. The model indicates that the use of more effective trapping methods and an increase in public awareness could reduce the needed investments in formal surveillance activities.

AI.tldr: 本文开发了一个生物经济模型来优化瑞士六种优先检疫森林害虫的监测方案，旨在最小化管理成本。模型建议年投资118.7万瑞士法郎进行监测，监测力度因害虫种类和地区而异，并识别出两种害虫的正式监测不经济。

AI.method: 使用生物经济模型开发最优监测方案，分析不同害虫和地区的监测效果。

title: Living Well Within Limits In Ten Stylised Facts
affiliations: University of Leeds - Sustainability Research Institute, MTA-ELTE Lendület New Vision Research Group, affiliation not provided to SSRN, SOAS University of London, Independent, University of Leeds, affiliation not provided to SSRN, TU Dortmund University, University of Lausanne, University of Leeds - School of Geography, affiliation not provided to SSRN, Carleton University and affiliation not provided to SSRN

detail.title: Living Well Within Limits In Ten Stylised Facts
detail.abstract: In this paper, we synthesize the findings of the “Living Well Within Limits (LiLi)” research project. The purpose of the LiLi project was to study and help resolve a defining challenge of our time: how can 8 billion (and more) people live well within planetary limits? We present the analytic framework we developed to explore this question, based on a specific conceptualisation of human well-being, mediated through provisioning systems and operationalised within the context of planetary phenomena. We synthesize our research findings in the form of ten stylized facts. These describe how our social, economic, technical and political systems are currently misaligned with living well within limits, and how they could be transformed to support this goal. One core insight is that it is theoretically possible to satisfy the needs of all people while dramatically reducing global energy demand. This in turn exposes the importance of transforming economic and political systems, curtailing inequality, improving the socio-technical provisioning systems, and reshaping power away from profit accumulation and towards democratic engagement. To conclude, we put forward “Living Well Within Limits” as a novel interdisciplinary research domain which encourages active engagement with social and political movements to face our intertwined climate, ecological and social crises.

AI.tldr: 该论文提出了"在限制内良好生活"的研究框架，证明理论上可以在大幅减少全球能源需求的同时满足所有人的基本需求，强调需要转变经济政治系统、减少不平等、改善社会技术供给系统。
AI.research_question: 如何让80亿（及更多）人在地球限制内良好生活？
AI.motivation: 解决我们这个时代的一个决定性挑战：如何在行星限制内实现人类福祉
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于特定的人类福祉概念化，通过供给系统作为中介，并在行星现象背景下操作化
AI.method: 开发分析框架，综合"在限制内良好生活"研究项目的发现

AI.theory_contributions: 建立了"在限制内良好生活"作为新的跨学科研究领域，鼓励与社会政治运动积极互动
AI.practical_contributions: 揭示了转变经济政治系统、减少不平等、改善供给系统和重塑权力结构的重要性

title: The Extra Shot: How Post-Auction Bargaining Rewrites Auction Outcomes
affiliations: University of Chicago - Booth School of Business and

detail.title: The Extra Shot: How Post-Auction Bargaining Rewrites Auction Outcomes
detail.abstract: Many auctions do not end at the hammer. We study a two-stage design in which bidders compete in an ascending-clock English auction with a seller-chosen secret reserve in the first stage and, if the auction fails to clear, the highest bidder may pay a small-utility cost to make a one-shot take-it-or-leave-it offer under two-sided private information. Under standard regularity conditions, we characterize a pure-strategy Bayesian Nash equilibrium and show it is globally unique. The equilibrium has a two-regime structure with a simple threshold logic: when post-auction bargaining is unattractive, the optimal reserve equals the seller's value; when bargaining is attractive, the optimal reserve is strictly above the seller's value to shape entry and offers. Benchmarking against the full-commitment Pareto-efficient frontier shows that our two-stage mechanism yields payoff pairs that lie weakly inside that set, and are strictly Pareto-worse whenever bargaining costs are positive.

title: Where Government Falls Short: How Religious Institutions Became America’s True Immigrant Safety Net

detail.title: Where Government Falls Short: How Religious Institutions Became America’s True Immigrant Safety Net
detail.abstract: Religious institutions have long been an integral part of the immigrant story in the United States, but they are more than just places to pray. For many new arrivals, a church, mosque, or temple is the first and most reliable source of assistance, providing food, language classes, housing support, and above all, a sense of community. This paper argues that religious institutions address needs that government programs attempt to fulfill but often fall short of satisfying. They build trust with individuals and families by maintaining an active presence in the everyday life of a community. These close connections allow them to respond to issues based on immediate insight and feedback from their members. Further, they form personal relationships and show flexibility in providing aid, two areas in which public systems are lacking. As a case study, this paper examines the outreach and communication undertaken by the Plano Jamatkhana, a community center for the Ismaili Muslim community in North Texas. Through interviews with leaders from synagogues, mosques, and temples in the Dallas and Fort Worth areas and examination of official governmental documents, this research compares the Plano Jamatkhana more broadly to other religious institutions, asserting that faith-based institutions have become the primary safety net for immigrants in Texas and the United States as a whole. Finally, it asks what repercussions immigration policy in the United States might face if the most effective support for new arrivals does not come from the state but from faith communities.

AI.tldr: 本文认为宗教机构比政府项目更能有效满足移民需求，通过德克萨斯州普莱诺贾马特哈纳社区中心的案例研究，表明宗教机构已成为美国移民的主要安全网。

title: Marriage Equality and the First Amendment: A Pluralism Argument

detail.title: Marriage Equality and the First Amendment: A Pluralism Argument

declarations.declarationOfInterest: The author declares no personal, financial, or institutional conflicts of interest related to the research or its findings. This work was developed independently as a contribution to ongoing public scholarship on constitutional or civil rights.
declarations.ethicsApproval: This research did not involve human participants, interviews, or experimental data collection. Therefore, formal ethics approval was not required.
declarations.funderStatement: This research received no external funding. It was self-funded by the author.

detail.abstract: This paper re-frames the constitutional foundation of marriage equality as a First Amendment issue rooted in pluralism rather than solely a Fourteenth Amendment guarantee. It argues that defining marriage exclusively through one sect’s doctrine imposes religion in violation of the Establishment Clause while denying equal dignity under the Free Exercise Clause. Drawing on precedents such as Engel v. Vitale (1962), Torcaso v. Watkins (1961), West Virginia v. Barnette (1943), and Obergefell v. Hodges (2015), this framework asserts that marriage equality safeguards both freedom of and freedom from religion. The analysis connects this pluralist reading to broader questions of state neutrality in lawmaking, where government favoritism toward a single faith tradition threatens constitutional democracy. The paper concludes that the central question is not merely who may marry, but whether the United States will remain a nation of many faiths and traditions or become a theocracy in all but name.

AI.tldr: 本文重新构建婚姻平等的宪法基础，将其视为基于第一修正案多元主义的问题，而非仅第十四修正案的保障。认为仅通过某一教派教义定义婚姻违反了设立条款，同时剥夺了自由行使条款下的平等尊严。

title: Scaling Agile Scrum for Distributed Microservices

detail.title: Scaling Agile Scrum for Distributed Microservices
detail.abstract: In large-scale software projects involving over 200 team members and 20+ microservices, implementing Agile Scrum methodologies presents unique challenges, especially in remote and globally distributed environments. This paper explores a structured approach to managing such complexity through product ownership, requirement engineering, architectural alignment, and iterative customer engagement. It highlights how Agile principles are adapted to ensure safety compliance, cross-team collaboration, and DevOps integration in a high-stakes application development lifecycle.

title: How do Barbarians Get to the Gates? Private Equity Careers, Styles, and Returns
affiliations: University of Florida - Department of Finance, Insurance and Real Estate

detail.title: How do Barbarians Get to the Gates? Private Equity Careers, Styles, and Returns
detail.abstract: Why do some fund managers outperform others? I construct a novel dataset to study this question in private equity (PE), tracking the careers and deals of PE professionals who have deployed 97% of capital for U.S. PE firms over the past three decades. I find that about 40% of a PE partner's investment performance can be explained by which PE firm they worked at as a junior associate. Moreover, 60% of this early-career effect is accounted for by the identity of their primary mentor. Comparing deals led by former associates from the same firm or the same mentor provides evidence that these effects are driven by distinct approaches to capital structure and portfolio company management learned early in their careers. Instrumental variable estimates at the PE firm level document additional short-run effects of associate experiences: the loss of junior associates decreases deal-making activity. Overall, my results show that fund managers' long-term investing success is significantly related to where their investment careers begin.

AI.tldr: 本文研究发现，私募股权基金经理的长期投资表现中约40%可由其早期职业生涯所在的PE公司解释，其中60%的早期职业效应归因于其导师身份。这些效应源于早期学到的资本结构和投资组合公司管理方法。

title: Quantifying Innovation's Impact on CO2: A Meta Regression Analysis of Current Econometric Evidence

detail.title: Quantifying Innovation's Impact on CO2: A Meta Regression Analysis of Current Econometric Evidence
detail.abstract:
This study employs Meta-Regression Analysis (MRA) to assess the impact of innovation on CO2 emissions, synthesizing findings from 49 econometric studies. The analysis addresses publication bias and investigates the role of research design in shaping reported estimates. Results confirm that while innovation generally reduces CO2 emissions, its effectiveness is highly heterogeneous. The findings ultimately produce extensive evidence on the theoretical aspects of eco-innovation. These insights clarify the conditions under which innovation serves as a driver of environmental sustainability.

This version is also archived on Zenodo: 10.5281/zenodo.17266456

AI.tldr: 本研究使用元回归分析评估创新对CO2排放的影响，综合了49项计量经济学研究的结果。分析发现创新总体上减少CO2排放，但效果存在高度异质性。研究还探讨了发表偏倚和研究设计对估计结果的影响。

title: The Turkish Commercial Agent’s Indemnity (Compensation) Claim and Its Derogability (Waivability) in German–Turkish Legal Relations
affiliations: Kadir Has University

detail.title: The Turkish Commercial Agent’s Indemnity (Compensation) Claim and Its Derogability (Waivability) in German–Turkish Legal Relations
detail.abstract:
The article—first published in German in RIW (Recht der Internationalen Wirtschaft) 2011 (pp. 125–133) as “Ausgleichsanspruch des türkischen Handelsvertreters und dessen Abdingbarkeit im deutsch-türkischen Rechtsverkehr”—examines whether and how a Turkish commercial agent’s customer-goodwill indemnity (portfolio compensation) can be excluded in contracts between German principals and Turkish agents. It traces the historical Turkish framework, explains how case law and sectoral statutes had already recognized a de facto indemnity, and compares outcomes before German and Turkish courts, including recognition/enforcement implications. Since publication, Turkey has adopted the new Turkish Commercial Code No. 6102 (largely in force since 1 July 2012). 

The Code now codifies the agent’s indemnity in Article 122, broadly modeled on § 89b HGB: the claim arises where the principal continues to benefit from customers brought in by the agent after termination, the agent loses commissions it would have earned if the relationship had continued, and payment is equitable. The amount is capped at the average of the agent’s annual remuneration over the last five years (or the shorter actual term), it cannot be waived in advance, and it must be asserted within one year; the claim is excluded if the agent terminates without justification or if the principal terminates for the agent’s culpable breach. Article 122 also allows analogy to comparable long-term distribution relationships where equity demands. 

Against this background, the article’s core theses remain valid: Turkish law treats the indemnity as mandatory and resistant to advance waiver; German courts, by contrast, may uphold exclusions for agents operating outside the EU/EEA under § 92c HGB. This asymmetry creates practical forum and enforcement risks in German-Turkish commerce: a Turkish judgment awarding indemnity stands a good chance of being recognized in Germany, whereas a German judgment that dismisses the indemnity based on a § 92c exclusion may face ordre-public objections in Turkey. 

A complete English translation of the article is available at http://dx.doi.org/10.2139/ssrn.5490007

AI.tldr: 该文章探讨土耳其商业代理人的客户商誉补偿金在德国委托人与土耳其代理人之间的合同中是否可被排除。研究发现土耳其法律将该补偿金视为强制性权利，而德国法院可能根据§92c HGB支持对非欧盟/EEA代理人的排除条款，这种不对称性在德土贸易中产生实际风险。

title: Work Comes First: The Syntactic Deception of The Term ‘Work-Life Balance’

detail.title: Work Comes First: The Syntactic Deception of The Term ‘Work-Life Balance’

declarations.declarationOfInterest: The author declares no personal or financial relationships with other people or organizations that could inappropriately influence or bias the content of this study.
declarations.ethicsApproval: This study did not involve human participants or animals; therefore, ethics approval was not required.
declarations.funderStatement: This research received no external funding.

detail.abstract: This paper presents a critical psycholinguistic analysis of the term "work-life balance," arguing that its widespread adoption is rooted in a deceptive and powerful syntactic choice: the placement of "work" before "life." We posit that this specific word order is not incidental but functions as a strategic cognitive prime. Through constant repetition in corporate discourse, the phrase subconsciously conditions employees to grant primacy to their professional obligations, framing "life" as a secondary concern to be managed around the non-negotiable anchor of "work." Integrating principles of the primacy effect, neurolinguistics, and Critical Management Studies, this paper deconstructs how this seemingly innocuous term serves as a tool for manufacturing employee consent to a work-centric worldview. The analysis demonstrates that the term's primary function is to benefit employers by shaping employee mindset, thereby revealing the core deception embedded in its very structure.

AI.tldr: 本文批判性地分析了"工作与生活平衡"这一术语，认为其语法结构（"工作"在前"生活"在后）是一种认知启动策略，通过不断重复潜意识地让员工将职业义务置于首位，将"生活"视为围绕"工作"这一不可协商锚点的次要关注点。
AI.research_question: "工作与生活平衡"这一术语的语法结构如何作为认知启动策略，影响员工对工作与生活优先级的认知？
AI.motivation: 揭示看似中性的"工作与生活平衡"术语实际上是一种语言操纵工具，服务于雇主利益，塑造员工以工作为中心的世界观。
AI.theoretical_framework: 首因效应、神经语言学、批判管理研究
AI.method: 批判性心理语言分析
AI.findings: "工作与生活平衡"的词语顺序不是偶然的，而是战略性的认知启动，通过企业话语的不断重复，潜意识地让员工将职业义务置于首位。
AI.theory_contributions: 为语言如何作为权力工具塑造员工心态提供了新的理论视角，扩展了批判管理研究的语言学维度。
AI.practical_contributions: 帮助员工识别和抵制语言操纵，促进对工作场所话语的批判性反思，为更平衡的工作生活关系提供认知基础。

title: International reserves as a pillar of policy of BRICS’ central banks amid global geopolitical shocks: VECM-analysis of Brazil and Russia
affiliations: MGIMO University

detail.title: International reserves as a pillar of policy of BRICS’ central banks amid global geopolitical shocks: VECM-analysis of Brazil and Russia
detail.abstract: During the geopolitically turbulent years of 2020-2024 the founder countries of the BRICS accumulated 72% of the rest of the world's international reserves (IR), which led them to rely on self-insurance against the risks of financial liberalization or domestic economic shocks. This study focuses on a comparative analysis of IR supply and demand factors (precautionary and operational functions) using error-corrected vector autoregression (VECM). Calculations demonstrated the role of external economic factors for the policy of the Central Bank of Brazil (CBB) and the Bank of Russia (BR) in terms of IR and dominant factors at points of geopolitical shocks (2020-2022 and Q2 2022-2024). Based on a graphical analysis of the dynamics of external sector indicators with IR adequacy indicators for Brazil and Russia as well as procedures for diagnosing the statistical character of data since 2020 to 2024, we determined that trade, monetary, and debt indicators would form IR functions. The identified non-stationarity of the sample time series predetermined the selection of cointegration pairs using the Engle-Granger method, and the Granger test. We also calculated range of safe IR fluctuations for CBB and BR, for example, which showed that the BBC's liquidity buffer was sufficient to maintain 9 months of export and import settlements until June 30, 2021, and to cover 6 months of payments on external obligations until June 30 2022. That may be explained as a response to the geopolitical events of the period under review. The VECM cointegration equations showed which variables influenced the IR of Brazil and Russia in the short term, their contribution to the long-term equilibrium state of IR adequacy, and which combination of factors determines the speed of IR recovery after an external shock. The resulting analysis of the reaction of the CBB and BR to changes in the factors themselves revealed that external risks are transmitted more intensively through exports in both countries.

AI.tldr: 本研究使用误差修正向量自回归模型比较分析金砖国家国际储备的供需因素，发现巴西和俄罗斯央行在2020-2024年地缘政治动荡期间，外部经济因素对国际储备政策起关键作用，外部风险主要通过出口渠道传导。

title: Global Supply Chains and Policy Shocks: Implications for Sectoral Wages
affiliations: Florida International University (FIU) - Department of Economics

detail.title: Global Supply Chains and Policy Shocks: Implications for Sectoral Wages
detail.abstract: This paper investigates the effects of four major shocks of global supply chain disruptions, trade policy uncertainty, tariffs, and monetary policy on U.S. sectoral wages from March 2007 to June 2025. Using a Bayesian structural vector autoregression model, we analyze both the dynamic response of wages via impulse response functions and the primary drivers of their volatility via forecast error variance decompositions. The results reveal significant sectoral heterogeneity, where supply chain disruptions are a potent inflationary force on wages, especially in the service sector, while trade policy uncertainty serves as a broad deflationary headwind. Tariff shocks create a clear divide between winning and losing sectors, and contractionary monetary policy has its strongest dampening effect on interest-rate-sensitive goods-producing industries. By jointly analyzing these shocks at a granular level, this study uncovers crucial labor market dynamics masked by aggregate data and identifies the distinct forces shaping sectoral wage growth.

AI.tldr: 本文使用贝叶斯结构向量自回归模型分析全球供应链中断、贸易政策不确定性、关税和货币政策四大冲击对2007年3月至2025年6月美国部门工资的影响，发现显著的部门异质性。
AI.research_question: 四大冲击（全球供应链中断、贸易政策不确定性、关税和货币政策）如何影响美国各部门的工资？
AI.motivation: 揭示被总体数据掩盖的关键劳动力市场动态，识别影响部门工资增长的不同力量。
AI.theoretical_framework: 贝叶斯结构向量自回归模型，脉冲响应函数，预测误差方差分解。
AI.method: 使用贝叶斯结构向量自回归模型分析2007年3月至2025年6月的数据，通过脉冲响应函数分析工资的动态响应，通过预测误差方差分解分析工资波动的主要驱动因素。
AI.findings: 显著的部门异质性：供应链中断是工资的强通胀力量（尤其在服务业），贸易政策不确定性是广泛的通缩阻力，关税冲击在赢家和输家部门间造成明显分化，紧缩货币政策对利率敏感的商品生产行业抑制效果最强。
AI.theory_contributions: 在细粒度层面联合分析多种冲击，揭示总体数据掩盖的劳动力市场动态。
AI.practical_contributions: 识别不同冲击对各部门工资的差异化影响，为政策制定提供部门层面的精准指导。

title: RDFNet: Region-induced Dual-branch Fusion Network for RGB-T Salient Object Detection
affiliations: Lishui University, Shandong University, Huzhou University, Hangzhou Dianzi University and Zhejiang University

detail.title: RDFNet: Region-induced Dual-branch Fusion Network for RGB-T Salient Object Detection
detail.abstract: Saliency detection methods major in RGB images have made great progress with the help of convolutional neural networks (CNNs). However, the performance of the above methods is severely degraded when dealing with dark light scenes depicted by low illumination  and darkness. To tackle the above challenges, we attempt to introduce  thermal infrared images to execute salient object detection, where the thermal images are robustness against illumination and occlusion. In this paper, we propose the Region-induced Dual-branch Fusion Network (RDFNet) for RGB-T salient object detection, which exploits dual-branch structure to mine the object information embedded in the RGB and thermal images. In RDFNet, two branches (\emph{i.e.}, $T\rightarrow RGB$ and $RGB\rightarrow T$) equipped with the saliency guidance (SG) units generate the coarse saliency map to guide RGB and thremal images concentrate on the saliency regions. Then, the region-induced features are fed into multi-scale global feature guidance (MGFG) unit, where the feature guided connection transfers the semantic features extracted from the multi-scale global fusion (MGF) module to other layers. Finally, a dual-branch fusion (DF) unit is deployed to combine features from two branches for yielding the high quality saliency map. Extensive experiments on three public RGB-T datasets demonstrate that our RDFNet outperforms the existing state-of-the-art methods in terms of all evaluation metrics.

AI.tldr: 本文提出RDFNet网络用于RGB-T显著目标检测，通过双分支结构融合RGB和热红外图像，解决低光照场景下RGB图像显著检测性能下降的问题。
AI.research_question: 如何在低光照场景下有效融合RGB和热红外图像进行显著目标检测？
AI.motivation: 传统基于RGB图像的显著检测方法在低光照和黑暗场景下性能严重下降，而热红外图像对光照变化和遮挡具有鲁棒性。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于双分支融合网络架构，利用RGB和热红外图像的互补特性。
AI.method: 提出RDFNet网络，包含T→RGB和RGB→T两个分支，采用显著性引导单元、多尺度全局特征引导单元和双分支融合单元。
AI.findings: 在三个公开RGB-T数据集上的实验表明，RDFNet在所有评估指标上都优于现有最先进方法。
AI.theory_contributions: 提出了区域诱导的双分支融合网络框架，为多模态显著检测提供了新的理论方法。
AI.practical_contributions: 解决了低光照场景下的显著目标检测问题，为实际应用如监控、自动驾驶等提供了有效解决方案。

detail.abstract: Uniformity of money is a topic that has gained increasing attention with the emergence of new forms of digital money. It describes the principle that different forms of money in the same currency are used and traded at par, i.e., at the same value. This economic note shows why uniformity of money is important for central banks and what factors underpin it. The note outlines measures to support these factors and finishes by introducing a layered perspective on the concept of uniformity of money.

title: Analysis of California’s Resilience Investments in Disadvantaged Communities
affiliations: San Diego State University, San Diego State University and San Diego State University

detail.title: Analysis of California’s Resilience Investments in Disadvantaged Communities
detail.abstract: This study examines California’s Community Power Resiliency Program, a state-funded initiative designed to strengthen the resilience of disadvantaged communities against energy loss. This study reviews the 2019–20 and 2020–21 funding cycles, analyzing disparities in funding allocation, the effectiveness of resilience investments, and the administrative and technical challenges faced by smaller jurisdictions. Through qualitative analysis of interviews and program documentation, this study evaluates how locally administered, grant-funded projects mitigated power outage impacts on public health, safety, and commerce. Findings reveal that while the investments provided short-term relief, long-term sustainability remains a challenge, particularly for underresourced communities and tribal communities. Key barriers include complex application processes, inconsistent reporting requirements, and restrictions on fund usage, limiting local flexibility in resilience planning. The findings provide recommendations for policymakers to enhance future funding distribution, balancing immediate relief with long-term resilience. This research underscores the policy need for sustained funding and expanded investment in infrastructure to strengthen both emergency preparedness and long-term resilience.

AI.tldr: 本研究分析了加州社区电力韧性计划在2019-20和2020-21年度的资金分配情况，发现该计划为弱势社区提供了短期电力中断缓解，但长期可持续性面临挑战，特别是资源匮乏和部落社区。主要障碍包括复杂的申请流程、不一致的报告要求和资金使用限制。
AI.research_question: 加州社区电力韧性计划在资金分配、投资效果和行政技术挑战方面存在哪些差异？
AI.motivation: 评估州资助计划如何增强弱势社区对能源损失的韧性，特别是关注资金分配公平性和投资有效性。
AI.theoretical_framework: 社区韧性理论、能源公平理论、公共政策评估框架
AI.method: 通过对访谈和项目文档的定性分析，评估地方管理的资助项目如何缓解电力中断对公共卫生、安全和商业的影响
AI.findings: 投资提供了短期缓解，但长期可持续性面临挑战；复杂申请流程、不一致报告要求和资金使用限制限制了地方韧性规划的灵活性

title: Discursive Governance and Indigenous Rights in Medicines Regulation: A Case Study of Rongoā Māori in New Zealand
affiliations: Victoria University of Wellington - Te Herenga Waka

detail.title: Discursive Governance and Indigenous Rights in Medicines Regulation: A Case Study of Rongoā Māori in New Zealand

declarations.declarationOfInterest: Nil
declarations.funderStatement: Nil

detail.abstract:
Aims
To examine Rongoā Māori across the Therapeutic Products Act 2023 and the subsequent Medicines Amendment Bill, and to assess implications for Māori health equity.
Methods
Critical Discourse Analysis, guided by Kaupapa Māori principles and informed by discursive institutionalism, was applied to a curated corpus of 23 primary sources (2022-2025). 35 excerpts were coded, with descriptive patterning (counts/co-occurrence) reported. Outputs include an evidence map (documents, themes and actors) and a policy options table translating findings into implementable regulatory choices with equity implications.
Results
Clear patterned differences emerged between eras. During the TPA era, Māori rights and partnership framings predominated (e.g., 'Framing Taonga' and 'Discourse Partnership' codes were frequent), whereas repeal-era texts were characterised by strategic silence on Te Tiriti and by 'Framing Complication'. The corpus-level patterns indicate a shift from legislated partnership and protection toward deregulation discourse.
Conclusions
The legislative reversal reoriented discourse from protection of a taonga and structured partnership toward regulatory simplification, with likely adverse implications for Māori health equity. As an explanatory case study, the findings highlight how discursive strategies (strategic silence, reframing) can enable rapid policy reversals that sideline Te Tiriti. Policy options are proposed to restore partnership and protection in future regulatory design.

AI.tldr: 该研究通过批判性话语分析考察了新西兰治疗产品法案2023和后续药品修正法案对毛利传统医学Rongoā Māori的影响，发现立法逆转导致从保护毛利权利和伙伴关系转向放松管制，可能对毛利健康公平产生负面影响。
AI.research_question: Rongoā Māori在治疗产品法案2023和药品修正法案中的定位如何？这些立法变化对毛利健康公平有何影响？
AI.motivation: 研究旨在理解立法政策变化如何影响毛利传统医学的保护和毛利健康公平，特别是在政策逆转背景下。
AI.theoretical_framework: 批判性话语分析、Kaupapa毛利原则、话语制度主义
AI.method: 对23个主要来源（2022-2025年）进行批判性话语分析，编码35个摘录，报告描述性模式（计数/共现），产出证据图和政策选项表。
AI.findings: 法案时期毛利权利和伙伴关系框架占主导，而废除时期文本以对《怀唐伊条约》的战略沉默和"框架复杂化"为特征，表明从立法伙伴关系保护转向放松管制话语。
AI.theory_contributions: 揭示了话语策略（战略沉默、重新框架化）如何促成快速政策逆转，为理解政策话语变化提供了理论解释。
AI.practical_contributions: 提出了恢复伙伴关系和保护的政策选项，为未来监管设计提供可实施的监管选择。

title: External Adjustment, Financial Fragility, and the Paradox of Stability in Emerging Economies
affiliations: affiliation not provided to SSRN

detail.title: External Adjustment, Financial Fragility, and the Paradox of Stability in Emerging Economies
detail.abstract: Global financial crises have highlighted the external vulnerability of emerging economies, where apparent stability in the trade balance often coexists with persistent external deficits. This study examines the so-called “paradox of stability,” in which external adjustments during crisis episodes occur mainly through import compression and external credit rationing rather than through structural improvements in competitiveness or sustainable financing. A panel of 20 emerging economies from Latin America, Asia-Pacific, and Africa was constructed for the period 1990–2023. Country-year fixed effects models and triple-difference (triple-diff) specifications incorporating interactions with the credit-deepening variable (HighPC) were estimated. Robustness and placebo tests were performed to assess the structural persistence of external adjustment.The results show that global crises generate temporary trade surpluses (L2, L1, T0), followed by a reversal in subsequent years. However, the net external deficit exhibits no significant changes, indicating a neutralisation via the income and services account. Financial deepening does not alter this pattern, suggesting that the dominant channel is external rather than domestic credit. These findings confirm that external improvement during crises reflects accounting and temporary adjustments, not structural transformations. The observed stability may therefore conceal latent financial fragility, aligning with the literature on the global financial cycle and the limited effectiveness of macroprudential buffers in emerging economies.

AI.tldr: 新兴经济体在全球金融危机中表现出外部调整的稳定性悖论：贸易顺差只是暂时现象，主要由进口压缩和外部信贷配给驱动，而非结构性竞争力改善，外部赤字问题并未真正解决。
AI.research_question: 全球金融危机期间新兴经济体的外部调整机制是什么？这种调整是否反映了结构性改善还是暂时的会计调整？
AI.motivation: 全球金融危机凸显了新兴经济体的外部脆弱性，贸易平衡的表面稳定往往与持续的外部赤字并存，需要理解这种稳定性悖论背后的机制。
AI.theoretical_framework: 外部稳定性悖论理论、全球金融周期理论、新兴经济体外部脆弱性理论
AI.method: 构建1990-2023年20个新兴经济体的面板数据，使用国家-年份固定效应模型和三重差分法，结合信贷深化变量进行交互分析，并进行稳健性和安慰剂检验
AI.findings: 全球危机产生暂时的贸易顺差，但随后出现逆转；净外部赤字无显著变化，表明通过收入和经常账户中性化；金融深化不改变这一模式，主要渠道是外部信贷而非国内信贷
AI.theory_contributions: 证实了外部稳定性悖论的存在，揭示了危机期间外部调整的暂时性和非结构性特征，支持全球金融周期理论
AI.practical_contributions: 为政策制定者提供警示：表面稳定的贸易平衡可能掩盖潜在的金融脆弱性，宏观审慎政策在新兴经济体的有效性有限

title: Generative AI at the Workplace and Protection of Workers' Rights
affiliations: RMIT

detail.title: Generative AI at the Workplace and Protection of Workers' Rights
detail.abstract: Generative AI (GenAI) is a general-purpose technology that involves a creative destruction of jobs and skills impacting all labour markets. Early productivity gains may benefit less skilled workers differently than previous technologies, potentially impacting inequalities between workers. We argue that GenAI deployment choices are irreversible and will become locked in through switching costs and path dependence within workplaces. We demonstrate that job quality is significantly disrupted by GenAI, with the emergence of new AI-related occupational risks that necessitate a review of health and safety protection laws. Our argument is that embedding worker voice in AI governance requires open-source rather than proprietary systems, as open source models allow information sharing necessary for effective collective bargaining. We propose a research agenda that emphasises representative workplace datasets, longitudinal studies of ethical deployment frameworks, and interdisciplinary collaboration to ensure that GenAI enhances rather than undermines dignified work and democratic workplace governance.

AI.tldr: 生成式AI作为通用技术将重塑就业市场，早期生产力收益可能对低技能工人产生不同影响。AI部署具有路径依赖性，会显著影响工作质量并带来新的职业风险。开源系统对于工人参与AI治理至关重要，需要建立研究议程确保AI促进有尊严的工作和民主治理。
AI.research_question: 生成式AI如何影响劳动力市场的不平等、工作质量和工人参与治理？
AI.motivation: 生成式AI作为通用技术将带来创造性破坏，其部署选择具有不可逆性，可能通过路径依赖锁定不平等模式，同时AI的引入会显著改变工作质量并带来新的职业风险。
AI.theoretical_framework: 创造性破坏理论、路径依赖理论、劳动过程理论、集体谈判理论
AI.method: 理论分析框架构建，基于现有文献和政策分析
AI.findings: 1) 生成式AI早期生产力收益可能对低技能工人产生不同影响；2) AI部署具有不可逆性和路径依赖特征；3) AI显著改变工作质量并带来新的职业风险；4) 开源系统对工人参与AI治理至关重要
AI.theory_contributions: 1) 拓展了生成式AI对劳动力市场影响的理论框架；2) 提出了AI部署的路径依赖和锁定效应理论；3) 发展了工人参与AI治理的理论基础
AI.practical_contributions: 1) 呼吁修订职业健康安全法规以应对AI相关风险；2) 提出开源系统作为工人参与治理的解决方案；3) 建立了包含代表性工作场所数据和纵向研究的研究议程

title: The Participation Puzzle: Gender Disparities in Unpaid Care Work in India
affiliations: Apna.Co

detail.title: The Participation Puzzle: Gender Disparities in Unpaid Care Work in India
detail.abstract: We decompose gender disparities in unpaid care work using India's 2024 Time Use Survey (10.2 million observations, 139,489 households). Women perform unpaid care work at rates 3.5 times higher than men, yet conditional on participation, men and women work similar durations. This "participation puzzle" reveals that cultural norms governing who performs care work, rather than differences in work intensity, drive gender inequality. The pattern persists across education, employment, and household composition. Regression analysis confirms female gender predicts participation independent of all controls. Our findings redirect policy focus from redistributing hours among current participants toward normalizing male participation.

AI.tldr: 基于印度2024年时间使用调查数据，研究发现女性从事无偿照料工作的比例是男性的3.5倍，但参与后工作时长相似。性别不平等主要源于文化规范决定谁参与照料工作，而非工作强度差异。
AI.research_question: 什么因素驱动了无偿照料工作中的性别不平等？是参与率差异还是工作时长差异？
AI.motivation: 理解无偿照料工作中性别不平等的根本原因，为制定更有效的政策提供依据。
AI.theoretical_framework: 性别角色理论、文化规范理论、家庭劳动分工理论
AI.method: 使用印度2024年时间使用调查数据（1020万观察值，139,489户家庭）进行分解分析和回归分析
AI.findings: 女性从事无偿照料工作的参与率是男性的3.5倍，但一旦参与，男女工作时长相似。性别不平等主要由参与率差异驱动，而非工作时长差异。
AI.theory_contributions: 揭示了无偿照料工作中的"参与谜题"，强调文化规范在决定谁参与照料工作中的核心作用。
AI.practical_contributions: 政策重点应从在现有参与者中重新分配工作时间，转向规范男性参与无偿照料工作。

title: Pixel-Level Multi-dimensional Assessment of Global Crises Socioeconomic Impacts: From Financial Collapse to Pandemic Lockdown in the Nile River Basin
affiliations: Tongji University, Tongji University, affiliation not provided to SSRN, affiliation not provided to SSRN, affiliation not provided to SSRN, affiliation not provided to SSRN, Tongji University and affiliation not provided to SSRN

detail.title: Pixel-Level Multi-dimensional Assessment of Global Crises Socioeconomic Impacts: From Financial Collapse to Pandemic Lockdown in the Nile River Basin
detail.abstract: Global crises severely threaten sustainable development, disproportionately affecting vulnerable regions like Africa where conventional data often fail to capture multi-dimensional socioeconomic impacts. To achieve a high-resolution assessment and deeply understand how global crises reshape the economic landscape, this study developed a pixel-level multi-dimensional assessment to systematically compare the impacts of the 2008 Global Financial Crisis and the 2020 COVID-19 Pandemic across the data-scarce Nile River Basin. A novel Economic Impact Index (EII) integrates nighttime light remote sensing with core macroeconomic indicators to synthesize crisis effects on economic growth, poverty, and inequality into a unified metric. Results reveal the financial collapse acted as an intense, spatially selective shock with an impact magnitude 4.1 times greater than the pandemic, exacerbating inequality but enabling limited upward mobility (a 1.91% population shift to higher-income groups). In contrast, the pandemic lockdown induced synchronized socioeconomic stagnation, halting mobility across income groups (population variation ≤1%). The derived EII Shock Resilience (ESR) index further quantifies basin-wide relative resilience, revealing a clear typology of vulnerability and recovery among nations. This framework offers a transformative tool for high-resolution crisis impact monitoring, supporting critical insights for building spatially informed resilience in vulnerable regions.

AI.tldr: 本研究开发了一种像素级多维评估方法，整合夜间灯光遥感和宏观经济指标，比较2008年全球金融危机和2020年新冠疫情对尼罗河流域的影响。金融危机影响强度是疫情的4.1倍，加剧不平等但允许有限向上流动；疫情则导致同步停滞，阻碍收入流动。
AI.research_question: 全球危机如何重塑经济格局？金融危机和新冠疫情对尼罗河流域的多维社会经济影响有何差异？
AI.motivation: 全球危机严重威胁可持续发展，在非洲等脆弱地区，传统数据往往无法捕捉多维社会经济影响。需要高分辨率评估来理解危机如何重塑经济格局。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于经济冲击理论、不平等理论和区域韧性理论，整合遥感数据和宏观经济指标进行多维评估。
AI.method: 开发像素级多维评估方法，构建经济影响指数(EII)整合夜间灯光遥感和核心宏观经济指标，评估危机对经济增长、贫困和不平等的影响。
AI.findings: 金融危机是强烈的空间选择性冲击，影响强度是疫情的4.1倍，加剧不平等但允许1.91%人口向上流动；疫情导致同步停滞，人口变化≤1%。ESR指数量化了流域内各国的相对韧性。
AI.theory_contributions: 提出了整合遥感与宏观经济指标的多维危机评估框架，发展了经济影响指数和冲击韧性指数，为危机影响监测提供理论工具。
AI.practical_contributions: 为脆弱地区提供高分辨率危机影响监测工具，支持空间知情韧性建设，为政策制定提供关键见解。

title: A Factor-Based AI Approach for Developing Economies
affiliations: and Independent

detail.title: A Factor-Based AI Approach for Developing Economies
detail.abstract: The rapid revolution of Artificial Intelligence (AI) presents both unprecedented opportunities for economic growth and a significant risk of widening the global divide, particularly for developing nations with limited resources. Existing AI development strategies often provide broad guidance without offering concrete, actionable recommendations tailored to these countries' unique circumstances. This paper addresses this gap by re-evaluating the classical economic "factors of production"-Land, Labor, Capital, and Entrepreneurship-through an AI-specific lens. Through an extensive literature review and expert consultations, the research identifies key comparative advantages for developing countries. These include access to unique, context-rich local datasets (redefined as "Digital Land"), a large and adaptable workforce ideal for data annotation and human-in-the-loop processes ("Labor"), the strategic leveraging of capital-light approaches like open-source models and cloud computing ("Capital"), and a necessity-driven entrepreneurial culture ("Entrepreneurship"). The findings inform a set of concrete, factor-based policy recommendations designed to enable developing nations to leapfrog traditional development pathways, harness AI for local innovation, and promote inclusive growth, positioning them as active shapers and leaders rather than passive consumers of the global AI future.

AI.tldr: 本文重新审视经典生产要素理论，为发展中国家制定AI发展战略提供具体政策建议，帮助其利用数字土地、劳动力、资本和创业精神等比较优势，实现跨越式发展。
AI.research_question: 发展中国家如何利用其独特的比较优势来制定有效的AI发展战略，避免在全球AI革命中被边缘化？
AI.motivation: AI快速发展既带来经济增长机遇，也加剧全球数字鸿沟风险，现有AI发展战略缺乏针对发展中国家具体情况的可行建议。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于经典经济学"生产要素"理论（土地、劳动力、资本、创业精神），结合AI时代特点重新定义这些要素。
AI.method: 通过广泛的文献综述和专家咨询，识别发展中国家的关键比较优势。
AI.findings: 发展中国家在数字土地（本地特色数据集）、劳动力（数据标注和人工参与流程）、资本（轻资本方法如开源模型）和创业精神（需求驱动的创业文化）方面具有独特优势。
AI.theory_contributions: 将经典生产要素理论扩展到AI时代，为发展中国家AI发展战略提供新的理论框架。
AI.practical_contributions: 提供基于生产要素的具体政策建议，帮助发展中国家跨越传统发展路径，成为全球AI未来的积极塑造者而非被动消费者。

title: Centralized Drug Procurement for Affordable and Sustainable Healthcare: Evidence from China
affiliations: Singapore Management University, Central University of Finance and Economics (CUFE) - China Center for Human Capital and Labor Market Research, Peking University HSBC Business School, Peking University and Peking University

detail.title: Centralized Drug Procurement for Affordable and Sustainable Healthcare: Evidence from China

declarations.declarationOfInterest: No.
declarations.funderStatement: NSF of China, CUFE, SMU

detail.abstract: Governments worldwide face intensifying pressure to contain pharmaceutical spending, yet most policies achieve modest savings. China's centralized volume-based procurement (CVBP) offers a rare national-level policy experiment to examine whether a single public purchaser can achieve large and sustained reductions in drug costs. We compile a population-level dataset of all drug transactions from public insurance-covered hospitals in China (2019-2023). Exploiting the molecule-specific, batch-wise rollout of the first five CVBP rounds (2019-2021), we estimate average policy effects using a staggered difference-indifferences design. On average, CVBP reduced unit prices by 64%, increased drug utilization by 24%, and lowered total drug expenditure by 56%. If fully extended to all generics nationally, projected savings would amount to 0.52% of China's GDP. Moreover, the policy especially benefited low-income patients by increasing their access to more affordable drugs, despite worsening the general access to higherpriced branded drugs. The scale and magnitude of these effects are unprecedented for a single national procurement reform. The design features-compulsory buyer participation, volume guarantees for producers, and competitive bidding-appear central to performance. Our findings offer a generalizable template for procurement policy in settings where payers prioritize fiscal sustainability and equitable access.

AI.tldr: 中国集中带量采购政策通过强制性买家参与、产量保证和竞争性招标，使药品单价下降64%，使用量增加24%，总支出降低56%，为低收入患者提供了更可负担的药物，实现了前所未有的成本节约效果。
AI.research_question: 单一公共采购方能否实现大规模且持续的药物成本降低？
AI.motivation: 全球政府面临控制药品支出的压力，但大多数政策效果有限，中国集中带量采购提供了一个国家级政策实验机会。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于集中采购理论，强调强制性买家参与、产量保证和竞争性招标的设计特征。
AI.method: 利用中国2019-2023年公立医院所有药品交易数据，采用交错双重差分法分析前五轮集中带量采购的政策效应。
AI.findings: 集中带量采购使药品单价下降64%，使用量增加24%，总支出降低56%；若在全国推广，可节省GDP的0.52%；特别惠及低收入患者。
AI.theory_contributions: 提供了单一公共采购方实现大规模成本节约的理论证据，识别了关键设计特征的重要性。
AI.practical_contributions: 为其他国家的药品采购政策提供了可推广的模板，特别适用于优先考虑财政可持续性和公平获取的环境。

title: „Pax mundi … à la Paris 1919“ und die Lehren für heute daraus (Pax mundi … à la Paris 1919" and the Lessons for Today)

detail.title: „Pax mundi … à la Paris 1919“ und die Lehren für heute daraus (Pax mundi … à la Paris 1919" and the Lessons for Today)
detail.abstract:
German Abstract: Die folgenden Beiträge sind die schriftlichen erweiterten Versionen der Vorträge, die am Fakultätstag der Rechtswissenschaftlichen Fakultät am 23. Mai 2025 gehalten wurden. Das gemeinsame Thema, das mit einem Blick aus verschiedenen Epochen beleuchtet wurde, lautete "Pax Europeana. Wie regeln wir den Frieden?"
Die Siegermächte des Ersten Weltkrieges versuchten auf der Friedenskonferenz in Paris 1919 Frieden und die Schaffung einer neuen Weltordnung zu verbinden. Damit tat sich erstmals die Chance auf, eine „Pax mundi“ zu schaffen. Allerdings scheiterten die Peacemaker an dem hohen Anspruch. Dieses politische Scheitern hatte entsprechende Folgen, die noch heute zB im Nahen Osten spürbar sind.

English Abstract: At the Paris Peace Conference in 1919, the victorious powers of World War I attempted to combine peace with the creation of a new world order. This presented the first opportunity to create a “Pax mundi.” However, the peacemakers failed to meet their lofty goals. This political failure had consequences that are still felt today, for example in the Middle East.

title: The Role of Higher Educational Institutions in Shaping Rural Societies: A Case Study of the Central University of South Bihar
affiliations: Central University of South Bihar

detail.title: The Role of Higher Educational Institutions in Shaping Rural Societies: A Case Study of the Central University of South Bihar
detail.abstract: Throughout the ages, universities have played a crucial role in the development of societies. Through the creation of new knowledge and innovation, they shape the region in which they are established. However, the role of universities is not limited to education and innovation; they also act as catalysts for societal change. The current study focuses on the role of the Central University of South Bihar in increasing the educational awareness and improving law and order in the nearby three villages. For this study, a sample of 60 was collected from three nearby villages to understand the dynamic relationship between the Central University of South Bihar and nearby villages. The results confirm a strong relationship between the perception of educational awareness and perceived improvement in law and order following the establishment of CUSB.

AI.tldr: 本研究探讨了南比哈尔中央大学对周边三个村庄教育意识和法治改善的影响，通过60份样本证实大学建立后教育意识与法治改善之间存在强关联。
AI.research_question: 南比哈尔中央大学如何影响周边村庄的教育意识和法治状况？
AI.motivation: 大学不仅是教育和创新中心，更是社会变革的催化剂，需要研究其对周边社区的具体影响。
AI.theoretical_framework: 大学作为社会变革催化剂的理论框架，强调高等教育机构对区域发展的多重影响。
AI.method: 从三个邻近村庄收集60份样本，分析大学与村庄之间的动态关系。
AI.findings: 结果显示，南比哈尔中央大学建立后，教育意识感知与法治改善感知之间存在强烈正相关关系。
AI.theory_contributions: 深化了对大学作为社会变革催化剂角色的理解，特别是在发展中国家农村地区的应用。
AI.practical_contributions: 为政策制定者提供了实证依据，支持在农村地区建立高等教育机构以促进社区发展。

title: Gender, Health, and Aging: Evidence from India
affiliations: Azim Premji University and

detail.title: Gender, Health, and Aging: Evidence from India
detail.abstract: In this paper, we explore gender disparities in the relationship between self-reported health and observable health outcomes among older adults in India. Using data from the Longitudinal Aging Study in India (LASI), we study the link between self-reported health and observable health outcomes, and the possibility of heterogeneity by gender. We also examine the likely effect of an inheritance law amendment that provides women more equitable right over ancestral property on women's valuation of their own health. We find that people who have ever been diagnosed with a condition are less likely to report being in good health, depending on the specific condition. We do not find gender differences in self-reported health conditional on these diagnostic conditions. We find that conditional on the level of ADL-IADL difficulty, women report higher probability of good health. We find a similar pattern with respect to cognition, where conditional on cognition score women report worse health. We construct two frailty indices incorporating a range of distinct health deficits. For both of these indices we find that conditional on frailty score, women are more likely to report good health. All three of the previous findings are indicative of women underplaying their health issues compared to men. We find, at the same frailty level, women are more likely to report good health, if they belong to a state which did not enact an amendment to a state inheritance law prior to 2005 national amendment. We also find an additional year of being in a state without an inheritance law amendment increases the probability of reporting good health, at the same level of frailty. This is indicative of women being more likely to underreport their health status, if they are exposed to adverse gender norms and poorer bargaining power.

AI.tldr: 该研究探讨了印度老年人中自报健康与客观健康指标之间的性别差异，并分析了继承法修正案对女性健康自我评估的影响。研究发现女性倾向于低估自身健康问题，且这种倾向在性别规范更不利的地区更明显。
AI.research_question: 印度老年人自报健康与客观健康指标之间是否存在性别差异？继承法修正案如何影响女性对自身健康的评估？
AI.motivation: 理解健康评估中的性别差异，以及法律改革对女性健康认知的影响，有助于制定更有效的健康政策。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于健康评估理论、性别差异理论和法律改革影响理论，分析自报健康与客观健康指标的关系。
AI.method: 使用印度纵向老龄化研究(LASI)数据，通过回归分析研究自报健康与诊断疾病、ADL-IADL困难、认知功能和衰弱指数的关系，并分析继承法修正案的影响。
AI.findings: 1) 女性在同等ADL-IADL困难水平下更可能报告良好健康；2) 在同等认知得分下女性报告更差健康；3) 在同等衰弱水平下女性更可能报告良好健康；4) 未实施继承法修正案的州女性更可能低估健康问题。
AI.theory_contributions: 揭示了健康评估中的性别差异模式，证实了社会法律环境对女性健康认知的影响机制。
AI.practical_contributions: 为制定考虑性别差异的健康政策提供依据，强调法律改革在改善女性健康认知方面的重要性。

title: Cui Bono? The Rule of Law as a Technology of Hegemony
affiliations: Independent

detail.title: Cui Bono? The Rule of Law as a Technology of Hegemony

keywords: TWAIL (Third World Approaches to International Law)

detail.abstract: This article advances a critical genealogy of the modern international legal order, arguing that its primary function has not been to facilitate cosmopolitan peace but to universalize Western political and economic interests through the sophisticated technology of law. It excavates the colonial origins of this hegemony in the juridical doctrines of Francisco de Vitoria and Hugo Grotius, which legally constructed non-European peoples and spaces as deficient or empty (terra nullius). It then traces how this logic was refined into the nineteenth century’s explicit ‘standard of civilization,’ a positivist gatekeeping mechanism. The article contends that the post-WWII order represents a recalibration, not an abandonment, of this project. Through an analysis of the UN Security Council, the International Criminal Court, and most potently, the regimes of Investor-State Dispute Settlement (ISDS) and IMF conditionality, it demonstrates that conditional sovereignty remains the organizing principle of international law. The article concludes that this hegemonic architecture is so foundational that it necessitates a radical, decolonial re-imagination of international law beyond facile reform.

AI.tldr: 本文对现代国际法律秩序进行了批判性谱系分析，认为其主要功能不是促进世界和平，而是通过法律技术将西方政治经济利益普遍化。文章追溯了从维多利亚、格劳秀斯的殖民法学理论到19世纪'文明标准'的发展，并论证二战后秩序是对这一项目的重新校准而非放弃。
AI.research_question: 现代国际法律秩序的主要功能是什么？它是如何通过法律技术将西方利益普遍化的？
AI.motivation: 揭示国际法表面上的普世主义和平承诺背后的殖民权力结构，批判国际法作为西方霸权工具的本质。
AI.theoretical_framework: 批判法学理论、后殖民理论、谱系学方法、霸权理论
AI.method: 历史谱系学分析、文本分析、案例研究（联合国安理会、国际刑事法院、ISDS、IMF条件性）
AI.findings: 国际法的核心功能是普遍化西方利益；殖民逻辑从维多利亚、格劳秀斯延续至今；二战后秩序是殖民项目的重新校准；有条件的国家主权仍是国际法的组织原则
AI.theory_contributions: 提供了国际法的批判性谱系学分析；发展了后殖民国际法理论；揭示了国际法作为霸权技术的本质
AI.practical_contributions: 为国际法改革提供批判性视角；支持去殖民化的国际法重构；揭示现有国际制度的不公正性

title: Health Services Utilisation and Length of Stay for Patients Treated by Nurse Practitioners and Physicians in an Emergency Department: A Retrospective Observational Study
affiliations: Flinders University, Flinders University and Flinders University

detail.title: Health Services Utilisation and Length of Stay for Patients Treated by Nurse Practitioners and Physicians in an Emergency Department: A Retrospective Observational Study
detail.abstract: AbstractBackgroundOver the past decades, increased emergency department demand has led to the creation of the nurse practitioner role to address healthcare needs and physician shortages. Although studies have identified the effectiveness of employing nurse practitioners for achieving positive patient outcomes, cost comparisons with physicians are limited. ObjectiveThis study aims to compare health service utilisation and length of stay for patients treated by nurse practitioners versus physicians in a metropolitan emergency department. The primary outcome measure was health services utilisation, used to approximate treatment costs. Secondary outcome measures are the National Emergency Access Target compliance rates.DesignRetrospective observational study using 2019 data from Flinders Medical Centre’s routinely collected health database.Setting Flinders Medical Centre, a tertiary referral hospital in metropolitan Adelaide, South Australia.ParticipantsFrom the initial dataset consisting of 93,674 presentations, patients treated by nurse practitioners or physicians within the Australasian Triage Scale categories 2, 3, 4, and 5 were included. Duplicate entries were removed.MethodsAfter applying the inclusion criteria, a matched subset of 1,988 nurse practitioner patients and 20,984 physician patients was created. Patients were matched by diagnosis, age group, arrival mode, Australasian Triage Scale category and time of presentation using coarsened exact matching. Statistical analysis was performed using R version 4.2.3.Results Patients treated by nurse practitioners had lower Charlson index scores (76.4% index of 0 vs. 68.9%, p<0.001) and lower Australasian Triage Scale (97.2% category 3-5 vs 89.8%, p<0.001) compared to physician patients.Hospital admission rate, 5-day representation rates and 5-day re-admission rates were lower for patients treated by nurse practitioners by 32% (95%CI=1.25, 1.52, P<0.001), 28% (95%CI=0. 59, 0.87, P<0.001) and 93% (95%CI=0.00, 0.36, P<0.001) respectively. Hospital length of stay, 30-day representation and 30-day and 6-month hospital readmission were not statistically different. Wait time, treatment time, and emergency department length of stay were lower for nurse practitioner patients by 0.29 hr (95%CI=-0.18, -0.10), 0.62 hr (95%CI=-0.12, -0.03) and 1.10 hr (95%CI=-0.13, -0.07), respectively.   Staffing cost were $42.19 higher for each nurse practitioner patient ($157.27 versus $115.08), totalling an additional $97,374.52. However, savings of $34,830 due to shorter emergency department length of stay and $330,980 through lower hospital admission rates yielded net savings of $268,435.48.ConclusionsPatients treated by nurse practitioners showed lower hospital admission rates, 5-day representation rates, 5-day re-admission rates and emergency department length of stay. An overall estimated savings was achieved by employing nurse practitioners alongside physicians.

AI.tldr: 该研究比较了急诊科护士执业医师与医生治疗患者的医疗资源利用和住院时间，发现护士执业医师治疗的患者住院率、5天复诊率和5天再入院率更低，急诊科停留时间更短，总体实现了成本节约。
AI.research_question: 在都市急诊科中，护士执业医师与医生治疗的患者在医疗服务利用和住院时间方面有何差异？
AI.motivation: 急诊需求增加导致护士执业医师角色的创建，以解决医疗需求和医生短缺问题，但护士执业医师与医生的成本比较研究有限。
AI.theoretical_framework: 医疗资源利用理论、成本效益分析框架
AI.method: 回顾性观察研究，使用2019年Flinders医疗中心的常规收集健康数据库数据，采用粗化精确匹配方法匹配患者，使用R 4.2.3进行统计分析
AI.findings: 护士执业医师治疗的患者住院率降低32%，5天复诊率降低28%，5天再入院率降低93%，急诊科停留时间缩短1.10小时；虽然每位患者人员成本高出42.19美元，但通过缩短急诊停留时间和降低住院率实现了净节约268,435.48美元
AI.theory_contributions: 为护士执业医师在急诊科的成本效益提供了实证证据，支持护士执业医师在医疗系统中的价值
AI.practical_contributions: 为医疗机构配置护士执业医师提供了决策依据，证明护士执业医师与医生协同工作可以实现成本节约和改善患者结局

title: Exploring Sustainable Climate Financing for Wealth Building in African Small Businesses
affiliations: Regional Advisory Commision on Financial Markets

detail.title: Exploring Sustainable Climate Financing for Wealth Building in African Small Businesses
detail.abstract:
Small businesses in Africa will benefit from increasingly larger incentives to redirect capital to uninvested low-carbon initiatives. In defining a sustainable project approach to finance climate change in Africa, the aim is to promote an institutional governance and rule-based environment that is balanced to ensure climate change income doesn't sideline Africa's development. This is a good fit for Africa's Agenda 2063, which balances its sustainability within the context of the Africa Environmental Framework and the AU's Green Agenda for Africa and Climate Change Strategy. This approach helps set out pathways to address the needs of small businesses in the least developed countries and identifies a range of measures that could benefit them. The approach would seek the right solutions to specific problems, including changes to the market environment. The same approach includes why the international community needs to intervene in a market context and what issues this helps resolve.

A good fit would enable development agencies to develop a pipeline of small projects that could attract substantial financing from a range of investors. The rationale and logic must be comprehensive enough to stand up to the scrutiny of Congress, equivalents and other stakeholders in the bilateral donor community. The critical challenge is focusing on environmental and development benefits in this rapidly changing commercial market. These are necessary. While developing a liquid voluntary carbon market plays a vital role in matching the demand from the Northern Hemisphere with supply from the South, there are several issues with the CDM. Virtue can be gained from guiding private sector finance around the CDM, which remains a primary source of compliance demand for international project emissions reductions.

title: Towards an Enriched Research Approach to Evolutionary Economics: The Orientation of Macro-Meso-Micro Dynamics and Critical Realism

detail.title: Towards an Enriched Research Approach to Evolutionary Economics: The Orientation of Macro-Meso-Micro Dynamics and Critical Realism
detail.abstract: This paper examines the theoretical roots and methodological underpinnings of evolutionary economics, proposing a direction to enrich its research methodology. It contends that the field's core is built on a tripartite analysis of innovation dynamics, biological interpretations, and institutional transformations. By integrating this dialectical perspective with the macro-meso-micro framework and critical realism, a solid methodological foundation can be established for more comprehensive investigations in evolutionary economics research. The paper concludes by emphasizing the need for practical application within the field, highlighting the importance of operationalizing these aspects to improve the analytical and interpretive capabilities of existing pertinent methodologies.
